method.controls: Matched untouched and whole-file low-pass variants. Add brief matched level reduction, ordinary edits, AI-only voice replacements, natural background excerpts, and global EQ controls. The known voice replacements do not filter the whole mix and are negative for this physical measurement.
method.gate: At least 80 percent useful locations on each cutoff, at most one matched untouched or global-filter false flag, at most one flag among unfiltered voice replacements/ordinary controls/background, and a gain of at least ten useful intervals over the prior sound-transition leads.
method.point: Fixed 12 dB drop in both upper bands, bounded change in a middle band, and similar measurable flanks. No data-fitted point. Both flanks contain five 80 ms source cells. Ranges from 7 to 15 cells in two-cell steps.
method.positives: Zero-phase Butterworth whole-mix low-pass at 3400 or 3800 Hz, with 25 ms raised-cosine edit edges. Edit start and duration determined by exact source digest before inference. Recompute at least half edit coverage and 0.30 time IoU.
method.scope: Single submitted mixed track, six seconds, native PCM16 at 16 kHz. Report temporary upper-band attenuation as processing context and no AI weight.
